card.name: Comma or "either" before increases or decreases
card.fires_on: The word "either" (or a comma) right before a pair of opposite directions such as "increases or decreases". Mostly in the boxed warning on suicidality and behavior changes at dose changes.

card.writes: It promotes words like "positive" and "beneficial", suggesting it prepares for a direction or valence word to come.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name a direction of change, like going up or down.
